verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
More love, more power
More of You in my life
More love, more power
More of You in my life

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
I will worship You with all of my heart
And I will worship You with all of my mind
And I will worship You with all of my strength

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
For you are my God
You are my God

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
I will seek Your face with all of my heart
I will seek Your face with all of my mind
I will seek Your face with all of my strength

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
More faith, more passion
More of You in my life
More faith, more passion
More of You in my life
